messages.text: How do changes in RFIC validation technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

Changes in RFIC validation technology push the signaling tester toward newer-standard and prototype-feature validation: the CMX500 signaling tester is described with newly added Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn testing capabilities to validate a prototype Wi‑Fi 8 device and showcase Wi‑Fi 8 physical-layer features [27].
They also push validation toward AI/6G performance assessment, where the CMX500 one-box tester demonstrates downlink throughput gain in AI-based wireless transmission and the effect on video streaming user experience [26].
OTA/chamber-based validation also becomes part of the required capability, since the CMX500 signaling tester and SMBV100B generator are integrated with ETS-Lindgren chamber technology and EMQuest software to advance comprehensive wireless testing capabilities [28].
